content: Makili ma anateandaasau
Na ana ondo ba nyimi maParisa kaa ana o baala angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa nane deya Yeso a ne surǝ ba Urushalima nane bekaa na,
“Eyaaka atoma au neta tare makili mana Anateandaasau ne? O bena neta sabozo zongka ne lye epaolya ne.”
Na Yeso kabare nee na, “Eyaaka ying eta tare makili ma Ashili ne e tare makili maying?
Ashili a bekaa na, ‘Tare ate au, ka iini au, kangza pate ondooka wa zeela ate ka iini wai wa gwara aa wongha wai.’
Ying e baale na, ‘Pate ondooka wa bekaa ate ka iini wai na, epaaka maa ya kankama oying ka e, ma nya Ashili,’
wa nyana otare ate kaa iini wai ka e ne, azaa nyimi ee cakate angmǝ Ashili azaa makili maying naname.
Ying ana rendaza, Ishaya ondo beya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili wa beke oroka Ashili aza oying aa kap na,

content.text: “Aromo ana, ne tareng ka ongmǝ belle,
aa nyimi anyong ane neya macangcang kaa mi.
O girwǝ one aa mi taa ka edang ne,
obaala one o tare makili ma aromo,

content: Mapa maaka ma care oromo
Na Yeso rare o kurkǝnǝng aromo acak, aa ka bekaa nee na, “Konana ekang rosa.
Epa eeka e lyǝzǝ ongmǝ oromo eta ote ka wa ye ka madinǝ ne, soona epa eeka e susi ba ongmǝ eya ote ka oromo wa itǝ ka madinǝ.”
Na atoma kai ne deya kai nane bekaa kai na, “Orose obena maParisa ne kona o burǝ ka ne kona a angmǝ aa na?”
Na Yeso kabare na, “Pate epa eeka Ate ang o zaa shili ta wa gata ne, ayo mukǝ.
Arnang ka ne, ne arǝ ne ka neya windǝ arǝ lebenda. Urǝ wa windǝ urǝ lebenda, pate one neya kala a le'o.”
Na Biturusu bekaa na, “Bele ro masanto ma angmǝ aa gerpo ana ka ba beka.”
Na Yeso pirkǝ nee na, “A alea aa were aana e tata a maring na?
Eta rosa obena pate epa eeka e lyǝ ongmǝ e ale a lebangi e suri ba lepung sang?
A epaaka e susi ba ongmǝ e suri ba lenyong. Epa o susǝ a lenyong leme eya ote oromo ka wa itǝ ka madinǝ a begeshe ba Ashili.
Azaa o bena aa nyimi lenyong leyaa sǝrsǝzǝ madoola maa buru. Naa, o wongha oromo, o mora kaa ondaye ondo, o mora kaa Ogala, o eza bekǝri, o ana angmǝ, ka o cara leze.
Ennaa ote oromo kawa itǝ ka madinǝ a begeshe ba Ashili, o lya epa olya zora o sabo waya ta ote ka oromo waye ka madinǝ a begeshe ba Ashili ne.”
O eke lenyong a Ashili ondaaye o makeke ma Kan'ana
Nangka Yeso ka baya arakaname, naka ale a makeke ma Taya ka Sidon.
Na ondaye yende ka makeke ma Kan'ana deya a Yeso ka oruuzi na, “Kona egonegone eng Ateokora, kena ka Daoda, bozang, kagala kang obere o buru ooka waya nyimi kai waya zo gara kai.”
Na Yeso ta beka eyapa a wai ne. Aza nyimi na atoma kai ne deya a kai nane bosa kai na, “Tarangga wai kawa ale waya tare oro awa gare ro ka be koko.”
Naka kabare na, “Mi aa tonghang azaa emande epeng e Isrela kane wilǝ belle.”
Na ondaye ome wa deya nawa girwǝ ba ting kai aaka bose kai kangza na, “Ateokora kangkamang!”
Na Yeso kabare na, “Wata gwara a jeke epa olya ayana ka kare e ere ne.”
Na ondaaye me bekaa na, “Nyimia Ateokora, pate kaa nyimi, e ere donge ma ngmeskarong maaka ma taaru ba deze araaka ateakwilǝ lyeeze epa olya ne.”
Yeso ka lye ka aromo magu ma naaze
Na Yeso kabare naka bekaa ondaye me na, “Ondaye o eke lenyong leo ba Ashili wa gong, baya epa eeka oya gera me, e itǝ nyimi.” Ka o bekaa nyimi na obere oburu me wa arnang ka kagala kame.
Yeso ka womza aromo aa cake
Nangka Yeso ka baya a rame naka tare bee dǝki lepong le Galili. Naka zale ba zaa oyara naka cikǝ ba saname.
Na aromo acak ne deya kai. Nane de kaa ana ozantǝ, arǝ, agǝdǝ, ka arara, aa ana ondo ba cak, nane eke ne aa begeshe be Yeso naka womza ne.
Na epame tere apate aromo tukpwei azaa obena arara neya beya ngmǝ, agǝdǝ ya teweno, arǝ neya gonta, na pate one ne saba Ashili a maIsrela.
Yeso ka lye kaa aromo magu ma naaze

Azaa nyimi na Yeso ka rare atoma o kai naka bekaa nee na, “Eyang kona egonegone aromo aana, tomore to taaro naana o ngmeengme teye legwa kaane aa neta ne lya epa olya ne, kangza anta yeme o baya one aane ale ekomo ne adorana tana ne sau orona ne.”
Na atoma kai ne kabare nane bekaa kai na, “A baba te era a te cǝ epaolya a nyimi lerambo leena kate nya aromo acake aana?”
Na Yeso pirkǝ nee na, “Ma borode ma wondaa eye kaa mai?” Nane kabare na, “O sondaare kaa ekwala a baate.”
Naka ote aromo aa cake name nane cikǝ ba deze,
Nangka ka jeke maborode o sondaare ka ekwala me, naka wore o kona oleba ba Ashili, aaka pose mai aaka nya atoma kai, na nee kangza ne arseze aromo amea ne kurkǝnǝng.
Pate one ne lye na komana one tii, na atoma kurki ma ngmeskarong maaka ma lyǝ nama panza makende ma moole sondaare.
O gongha aromo aaka ne lye epaolya me ne dukǝ andaleme magu ma naaze bangka andaye kaa ayana.
Malo arnang ka aromo me, naka zale o onggo o taara manyi naka ale a makeke ma magadan.
